{{Quote|An Ankura Gungan&mdash;the ones with green skin and hooded eyes.|[[Leika]], on [[Ganne]]|<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Ankura''' were a race of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species. Unlike the [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]], Ankuras had hooded eyes, broad wide heads, and green skin. Like the Otolla, they had long ears, which were sometimes tied together behind the head.

==History==
The Ankuras had been separate and distant from other Gungans until the founding of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] by [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], an Ankuran. The new underwater city brought all Gungans together in a unified community, under the rule of the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]]. In the total Gunga population, the Ankurans made up a relatively small percentage; however, they long maintained a strong presence on the Council. Several Ankura Gungans thrived in [[Bartyn's Landing]], the capital city of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. [[Bamfurd]] managed and owned [[Bamfurd's Tapcafe]];<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> and a street wrestler named [[The Mighty Musstoro]] operated in the [[Center Sphere District]].<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>
